out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw beef was stored over ready to eat sauces in the meat walk. Raw beef was also being stored over an open container of cut onions in the same unit and raw egg were stored over sliced green peppers.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The person in charge had a food employee move all these foods to correct storage locations during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The final rinse of the main hot water dish machine was too low at 144º indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that the final rinse temperature reaches 160º. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. The person in charge contacted the service company during the inspection to have the unit serviced. Contact your EHS when the unit is repaired and working properly.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Five pans of refried beans in the walk-in that were cooked two days ago were out of temperature at 47º and above. Two trays of flan cooked more than a day ago were out of temperature at 44º in the same walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. The person in charge had the five pans of beans and two trays of flan discarded.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked shrimp, beef and chicken in pans over the griddle were not being held hot enough at 115º, 110º, and 100º, respectively.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The CFM discarded the food items.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut tomatoes on the prep line were not being held cold enough at 50º. Cooked ribs on the prep refrigerator were 110º. Pico de gallo on the cold rail was 48º. Cabbage slaw on the cold rail was 47º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The CFM discarded the tomatoes during the inspection. The CFM moved the ribs to the walk-in to cool. The pico de gallo and cabbage slaw were discarded.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: three 6 inch plastic containers of hot soup were not being cooled properly as the 6 inch containers were full. A large plastic container full of cooling ribs were stacked at least 8 inches high in the pan. The ribs on top of the pile were 50º, the ones in the middle were 60º and the ones on the bottom were 70º.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Discontinue stacking hot foods so high or deep in pans to cool as they won’t cool in 6 hours or less. The EHS discussed this with the person in charge and provided a handout (in Spanish) discussing proper cooling methods.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: there was no thermometer in the middle refrigerator at the ceviche station.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please provide a thermometer for this unit as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. Guapos of Merrifield (Inspection Date: 10/08/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Several food items (cased vegetables and five gallon buckets of food) were stored on the floor in the product walk-in,.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing foods on the floor. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the left side prep top unit at the ceviche bar was not keeping foods cold enough and the ambient temperature of the unit was 52º. Several foods in the walk-in 42º and the ambient temperature of the unit was 42º.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The technician arrived during the inspection and adjusted the unit. Have the walk-in refrigerator adjusted or serviced.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the main dishwasher was not working properly and the final sanitizing rinse was not high enough at 132º and 144º.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Discontinue using the machine and have it serviced as soon as possible. Contact your EHS when it is corrected.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed an employee handling fresh tortillas with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. The employee put on gloves soon after this observation. The EHS educated the PIC on this require requirement. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: The hand sink at the bar area was being used as a dump sink. The hand sink in the weight station area was being used to store pitchers of water in.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discontinue using the bar hand sink as a dump sink. There are plenty of other sinks in the bar area that could be used as a dump sink. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who discussed it with the bar staff and the wait staff. CDI

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels available at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected us by placing towels at the bar hand sink.CDI. Guapos of Merrifield (Inspection Date: 04/10/2026) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap available at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

The dishwasher in the back of the establishment also needs to be serviced so that is capable of sanitizing dishes at 160°F. Discontinue using this unit as well until it is serviced working properly.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a pan of cooked chicken breast and a pan of cooked steak was stored in stainless steel pans over the grill. The chicken breasts were not hot enough at 120 to 130°F. The steak was 130º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The location of this pan will not keep feeling hot enough. The chicken breast and steak were reheated to 165°F. CDI.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: there were two trays of flan in the walk-in refrigerator with expired expiration dates. One had an expiration date of 4/5/26 the other with an expiration date of 4/1/26. Both trays were expired, but had not been discarded as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC determined that needs trays were mislabeled. The tray that expired 4/5 was discarded the tray that expired 4/1 was re-labeled. Please keep accurate date labels on foods in order to avoid serving expired foods. Monitor expiration dates of all foods prepared on site (and other foods) and discard foods that have reached or passed their expiration dates.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed two uncovered full 6-inches tall containers of cooked chili that were 160° and cooling in the walk refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The chili will not cool in time due to the amount of product in the containers and the size of the containers. Foods must be cooled in shallow containers. The EHS discussed this with the PIC.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Containers of food were stored on the floor in the produce walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing foods on the floor. Move the foods to a shelf as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: at the wait station, the ice scoop handle was stored in the ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC corrected us during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: several foods in the walk-in were above 41°F. Most foods were 43°F and several were discarded due to this. The walk-in needs to be serviced because it is not keeping foods cold enough.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer

violations.corrective_action: Obtain test kits for bleach and quaternary ammonia within 10 days.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. There is a hose connected to a hose bib spigot without a backflow prevention device installed underneath the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Disconnect the hose to temporarily correct this violation. If the hose is still needed, install a hose bib spigot vacuum breaker before reinstalling.

violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Provide a covered trash receptacle in the employee unisex restroom as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

Guacamole was 58F and pico de gallo was 45F on the cold rail.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All products were discarded.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw salmon was thawing in the handsink at the ceviche station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. This was corrected by the PIC.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: there were several unlabeled food squeeze bottles in the expo area refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at bar, three compartment sink, expo, and cook line handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided hand cleanser at each hand washing sink.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at bar, three compartment, expo, and cook line handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towel at all hand sinks.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. Observed used shell stock tags for oysters and mussels without date of last shell stock use.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. PIC provided dates where able on all shell stock. EHS trained PIC and staff on proper shell stock procedures.

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: tilapia, salmon fillet
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC agreed to remove undercooked or raw tilapia and salmon until parasite destruction letters are received and sent to EHS.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw ground beef stored above raw shrimp in 1 dr upright on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC placed all raw animal foods according to cook temperature.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: cut and cleaned lemon and shredded cheese stored below raw beef in walk in cooler (R)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed lemons and cheese above raw beef. Guapos of Merrifield (Inspection Date: 01/08/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: pots, pans, glasses and plates from bar dish machine (155F), back dish machine (156F), and main dish machine (128F)
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC prepared bleach solution for the proper cleaning of all dish ware and sanitized all improperly cleaned dish ware.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Observed yellow rice (73F) after 2 hours in walk in cooler (L).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded rice.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: birria consomé (92F), melted butter (100F) at customer facing cook line. Cooked beef (123F) on main cook line. Blistered jalapeño (116F) on prep table at main cook line. Yellow rice (108F), white rice (104F) in expo steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC discarded and refreshed butter, beef, jalepeño, rice, and consomé.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut tomato (48F) in ice bath at expo. White rice (44-48F) in WIC (L)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded rice and tomato.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: express salad, tostada Laredo, Trilogia de Ceviches, and Rosita salad.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC will provide a star or asterisk for every ingredient in the aforementioned menu items that is an animal food available to be ordered undercooked or raw. This is to include house dressing, salmon, tilapia, beef steak, etc. Correction will be reviewed during follow-up inspection within 10 days.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: ready to eat toasted bread stored directly on shelf of 3 dr prep units at main cook line. Unprocessed onions stored below hand sink at back prep station.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. PIC discarded bread and placed onions in a clean location.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes stored on prep surfaces throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: knife stored between 2 dr prep units at customer facing cook line; spatulas and knives stored in ambient water (82F) at dessert prep station; ice scoop stored with handle in ice at bar.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed knife and water and properly cleaned all utensils. PIC placed ice scoop with handle stored above the level of consumable ice.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed the following heat sanitizing dish machines operating below 160F: bar dish machine (155F), back glassware dish machine (156F), main dish machine (128F)
violations.corrective_action: PIC prepared bleach solution for the proper sanitization of dish ware. PIC contacted technician and repair completed during inspection.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: molcajete
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. PIC will discontinue use of molcajete until a barrier is provided to be used between food and the contact surface of the molcajete. EHS trained PIC in regard to use case of molcajete and similar vessels.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Cast Iron
violations.observation: The following cast iron utensil is not properly used as a food-contact surface: all skillets used for fajitas
violations.corrective_action: Cast iron may not be used for utensils or food-contact surfaces of equipment unless used for cooking purposes or in utensils for serving food if utensils are used only as a part of an uninterrupted process from cooking through service. PIC will discontinue use of cast iron skillets. EHS discussed with PIC the approved use of cask iron as a cooking and serving surface.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the three compartment sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC will contact certified plumber and have repair completed before follow-up on 1/17.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floor drain grate at the tilt skillets is not maintained in good repair, with missing bar grating.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC will repair floor drain before inspection on 1/17
